name: Time Rewind
description: ⏪ Rewind time when you die! Instead of restarting, the game rewinds a few seconds like a VHS tape, letting you try again from that point. Limited rewinds per attempt for balanced gameplay.

enabled.name: ⏪ Enable Time Rewind
enabled.description: Master toggle for the time rewind feature.

rewind-duration.name: ⏱️ Rewind Duration
rewind-duration.description: How many seconds to rewind when you die.

rewind-speed.name: ⚡ Rewind Speed
rewind-speed.description: Playback speed of the rewind animation (1.0 = real-time, 2.0 = 2x faster).

max-rewinds.name: 🔢 Max Rewinds Per Attempt
max-rewinds.description: Number of rewinds allowed before normal death. Resets on level restart.

record-fps.name: 📹 Recording FPS
record-fps.description: Frames per second for state recording. Higher = smoother rewind, more memory.

visual-effects.name: 📺 VHS Visual Effects
visual-effects.description: Show retro VHS-style visual effects during rewind.
